title: Mitred
html_source: Mitred napkins have corners such that the fold on each edge meets with the fold on the other edge at a 45-degree angle (rather than overlapping with a contiguous edge’s fold). This is the same technique as a mitre joint in carpentry. Is the waiter sewing the napkins in this fashion, or is he folding them to look like a mitre (i.e., a bishop’s hat)?
